blocks.title: Homogeneous equilibrium
blocks.text: Woh equilibrium system jis mein sab reactants aur products ek hi phase mein hon, misal ke taur par N2(g) + 3H2(g) se 2NH3(g); 2SO2(g) + O2(g) se 2SO3(g); aur CH3COOH(l) + C2H5OH(l) se CH3COOC2H5(l) + H2O(l).

blocks.title: Heterogeneous equilibrium
blocks.text: Woh equilibrium jis mein reactants aur products ek se zyada phases mein hon, misal ke taur par CaCO3(s) se CaO(s) + CO2(g); C(s) + H2O(g) se CO(g) + H2(g); aur 3Fe(s) + 4H2O(g) se Fe3O4(s) + 4H2(g).

blocks.caption: Qism ke mutabiq misalein
rows: C(s) + H2O(g) se CO(g) + H2(g); 3Fe(s) + 4H2O(g) se Fe3O4(s) + 4H2(g)

blocks.prompt: Homogeneous aur heterogeneous equilibria mein farq batayein, aur CaCO3(s) se CaO(s) + CO2(g) ke liye equilibrium constant expression likhein.
blocks.explanation: Homogeneous equilibrium mein har species ek phase mein hai, jaise sab gases ya sab liquids; heterogeneous mein do ya zyada phases maujood hain, jaise gas ke saath solids. Khalis solids expression se kharij hain, to carbonate ke liye Kc = [CO2]: kisi darja hararat par solids ke oopar carbon dioxide ki concentration (ya dabao) muqarrar hai.

items: Homogeneous: ek phase (ammonia synthesis, SO3 banna, ester banna). Heterogeneous: kai phases (CaCO3 ka tootna, carbon aur steam, loha aur steam); solids Kc se kharij.
